## Fake support numbers

- Scammers buy search ads with fake support numbers. [FTC](https://www.example.gov/fake-numbers)
- Verify numbers on the official site. [FTC tips](https://www.example.gov/tips)
- Never pay by gift card. [FTC gift cards](https://www.example.gov/gift-cards)
